cards.flavorText: Poison Bloom was accused of plagiarizing the "Ooh, how long can this go on (ooh yeah)" hook from an old-school musical group called The Saronite Chain Gang.

cards.name: Low Security Wing
cards.text: Get a random Shaman minion. It's locked in your hand until you play another card.
cards.flavorText: It's not that these prisoners don't matter, it's that the guards are a little preoccupied.

cards.name: Lowly Squire
cards.text: Inspire: Gain +1 Attack.
cards.flavorText: But not the lowliest!

cards.name: Lucentbark

cards.flavorText: Always feels refreshed after a little dirt nap.

cards.flavorText: When you wish upon a star, your dreams will take you very far. When you wish upon a comet, your luck will make your opponent...

cards.name: Lumia
cards.text: Lifesteal After a hero takes damage, they become Immune for the rest of the turn.
cards.flavorText: "What's a world soul?" "Only the most sophisticated form of life ever protected by Titans. AND it's spherical! SPHERICAL!"

cards.name: Luminous Geode
cards.text: After a friendly minion is healed, give it +2 Attack.
cards.flavorText: No take candle. BE CANDLE.

cards.name: Luna's Pocket Galaxy
cards.text: Change the Cost of minions in your deck to (1).
cards.flavorText: Luna became head of the astronomy department when her boss invented the Pocket Black Hole.

cards.name: Lunar Eclipse
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Your next spell this turn costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: When the Azeroth is between the Sun and the Moon.

cards.name: Lunar Trailblazer
cards.text: Battlecry: Set the Cost of a random spell in your hand to this minion's Cost.
cards.flavorText: Changing legend into fact, she will ride into history.

cards.name: Lunar Visions
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Minions drawn cost (2) less.
cards.flavorText: The true mystery of lunar visions is how there is nothing to watch when there are so many channels.

cards.name: Lunarwing Messenger
cards.text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power.
cards.flavorText: Back in my day this is how we got friend requests.

cards.name: Lurker

cards.name: Lushwater Murcenary

cards.flavorText: You can't just switch sides because they have more fish!

cards.name: Lushwater Scout

cards.flavorText: Only knows how to play "Careless Murgl" and "Mrgl Mrgl Little Star."

cards.name: Lynessa Sunsorrow

cards.flavorText: A diet of pure magic is great for the complexion but wreaks havoc on one's mood.

cards.name: Lyra the Sunshard
cards.text: Whenever you cast a spell, add a random Priest spell to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Arise, fair sun, and kill my envious foes. They don't have a legendary as beautiful as you.

cards.name: M.O.T.H.E.R.
cards.text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of a card in your hand by (5). This continues to the left and right with (1) less reduction.
cards.flavorText: M.O.T.H.E.R HAS ARRIVED!

cards.name: MC Blingtron
cards.text: Battlecry: Both players equip 1/2 Microphones. Your opponent's increases all damage they take by 1!
cards.flavorText: If this is the outcome of the robot uprising, then sign me up!

cards.name: Mad Bomber
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage randomly split between all other characters.

cards.flavorText: He's entirely bonkers. All the best goblins are.

cards.name: Mad Scientist
cards.text: Deathrattle: Put a Secret from your deck into the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: His mother wanted him to be a mage or a warlock, but noooooooo, he had to go and be a scientist like his father.

cards.name: Mad Summoner
cards.text: Battlecry: Fill each player's board with 1/1 Imps.
cards.flavorText: Does he summon because of his madness, or is he mad from all the summoning?

cards.name: Madam Goya
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly minion. Summon any copies of it in your deck.
cards.flavorText: She has set up her Black Market here in Gadgetzan for one purpose, to make a KILLING when Beanie Babies make their inevitable comeback.

cards.name: Madame Lazul
cards.text: Battlecry: Discover a copy of a card in your opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText: Of course she knows the future, she’s been looking at your cards the WHOLE TIME!

cards.name: Madder Bomber
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage randomly split between all other characters.
cards.flavorText: Dang, Bomber, calm down.

cards.name: Maddest Bomber
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 12 damage randomly split among all other characters.
cards.flavorText: Talk about a name that limits design space.

cards.name: Maelstrom Portal

cards.flavorText: They bill this as a popular resort attraction, but they try and get your money up front.

cards.name: Maestra of the Masquerade
cards.text: You start the game as a different class until you play a Rogue card.
cards.flavorText: She doesn't drop character until after the DVD commentary.

cards.name: Maexxna

cards.name: Magehunter

cards.name: Magic Dart Frog

cards.flavorText: There's a powerful throat in this frog.

cards.name: Magic Trick
cards.text: Discover a spell that costs (3) or less.
cards.flavorText: The world is not ready for an illusion of this depth and intricacy!

cards.name: Magical Dollhouse

cards.flavorText: Build your own dollhouse in 3 easy steps! 1. Build a castle. 2. Miniaturize it. 3. GLITTER!

cards.name: Magicfin

cards.flavorText: The best part is when he pulls Deathwing out of a top hat!

cards.name: Magister Dawngrasp
cards.text: Battlecry: Recast a spell from each spell school you've cast this game.
cards.flavorText: Magister is a humble title for one who united warring armies against the greatest threat to Azeroth.

cards.name: Magister's Apprentice
cards.text: Your Arcane spells cost (1) less.

cards.flavorText: Don't say T.R.E.A.T. or he'll drool lava everywhere.

cards.name: Magma Rager

cards.flavorText: Playing him also gets you into the Magnataur Beta.

cards.name: Magnifying Glaive
cards.text: After your hero attacks, draw until you have 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: Vengeance!

cards.flavorText: Came from another world to invade Outland and bend it to his will… only to be overthrown by an elf from another world who invaded Outland and bent it to his will.

cards.name: Magtheridon, Unreleased
cards.text: Dormant for 2 turns. While Dormant, deal 3 damage to all enemies at the end of your turn.
cards.flavorText: Playing with this card can be penalized with up to a two-year suspension. Please wait until the card is officially released.

cards.name: Maiden of the Lake
cards.text: Your Hero Power costs (1).
cards.flavorText: Not a good basis for a system of government.

cards.name: Maiev Shadowsong
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. It goes Dormant for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: Go directly to Demon Jail. Do not attack minions, do not collect mana crystals.

cards.name: Mailbox Dancer
cards.text: Battlecry: Add a Coin to your hand. Deathrattle: Give your opponent one.
cards.flavorText: He is the reason why we have 7 mailboxes in this district.

cards.name: Majordomo Executus
cards.text: Deathrattle: Replace your hero with Ragnaros the Firelord.
cards.flavorText: You thought Executus turned you into Ragnaros, but really Ragnaros was in you the whole time.

cards.name: Making Mummies

cards.flavorText: "I do say, this gives me the vapors every single time!"

cards.name: Mal'Ganis

cards.name: Malchezaar's Imp

cards.flavorText: Malchezaar used to have an imp named Dobby working for him, but there was a tragic accident.

cards.name: Malefic Rook
cards.text: Battlecry: Attack YOUR hero.
cards.flavorText: Was a regular Pawn but Fel in with the wrong toys.

cards.name: Malevolent Mutant
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a Fel spell in your hand. Get a copy of it.
cards.flavorText: No more mister nice naguy.

cards.name: Malevolent Strike
cards.text: Destroy a minion. Costs (1) less for each card in your deck that didn't start there.
cards.flavorText: "I don't know how those got in there, but I'm blaming you two."

cards.name: Malfunction
cards.text: Deal 3 damage split among all enemy minions. If your deck has no minions, deal 3 more.
cards.flavorText: Bug Report: This card works perfectly.

cards.name: Malfurion the Pestilent

cards.name: Malfurion's Gift
cards.text: Discover a Temporary Feral Rage, Wild Growth, or Swipe.
cards.flavorText: "May this imbue you with the life of the party!" -Malfurion

cards.flavorText: Garrosh's best buddy. It's true. Look it up.

cards.flavorText: Two pumps blue raspberry. Two pumps cherry. Two pumps necrotic ooze.

cards.flavorText: Most celebrities nope out at this one.

cards.text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, gain +1/+1.

cards.flavorText: She’s trying to kick the habit, but still takes some mana whenever she has a stressful day.

cards.name: Mana Bind

cards.flavorText: Nice spell. YOINK!

cards.flavorText: It'll put a good spin on your spells.

cards.name: Mana Geode

cards.flavorText: Gadgetzan, where even the pet rocks have pet rocks.

cards.name: Mana Giant
cards.text: Costs (1) less for each card you've played this game that didn't start in your deck.
cards.flavorText: Spell more and save more with a GIANT discount!

cards.name: Mana Reservoir

cards.flavorText: If it soaks too long, it becomes a reservoir hog.

cards.flavorText: It is said that some shaman can say "Floatin' totem" 10 times, fast.

cards.name: Mana Wraith
